
 Usage: openajar node [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Set up and run this node.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ init                  Create OPENAJAR_HOME, write node.toml with an MCP      │
│                       token, and print how to connect.                       │
│ rotate-token          Replace the node's own token (node.toml mcp_token), so │
│                       copies of the old one stop working.                    │
│ serve                 Run agentosd: the lanes and the MCP server (systemd    │
│                       runs this).                                            │
│ join                  Join this node to a controller. agentosd keeps the     │
│                       channel up from its next start.                        │
│ templates             List the node templates, or show one: where its files  │
│                       are and the variables to fill in.                      │
│ restart               Restart agentosd, after naming the open lanes and who  │
│                       holds them (asks when any is held).                    │
│ logs                  agentosd's log, filtered on the ids every line carries │
│                       (lane, grant, run, workspace, request).                │
│ migrate-service-user  Run agentosd as its own user with the hardened unit    │
│                       instead of root (or --rollback).                       │
│ config                This node's settings.                                  │
│ doctor                Check this node and say how to fix what is wrong.      │
│ health                Node health: exit IPs, proxies, disk, RAM, browser     │
│                       drift.                                                 │
│ backup                Encrypted backups of OPENAJAR_HOME (profiles, vault,   │
│                       databases).                                            │
│ migrate               Versioned migrations of the databases and the lane     │
│                       directories.                                           │
│ upgrade               Drain, install, migrate, restart; roll back on         │
│                       failure.                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
